content.value_statement: Unreal Engine C++ has strict lifecycle, reflection, and memory rules. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward UE5 patterns.
actual_capabilities: Guides UObject pointer ownership with UPROPERTY and garbage collection rules.
Explains UCLASS, USTRUCT, UENUM, and UFUNCTION reflection usage.
Recommends Tick avoidance, timers, events, and cached references for performance.
Applies Unreal naming conventions for actors, objects, structs, enums, and booleans.
Advises on soft references to reduce hard asset load chains.
Provides review checklist guidance for delegates, Tick usage, and UObject members.
limitations: It targets Unreal Engine 5.x C++ projects, not Blueprint-only projects.
It gives guidance and examples, but it does not compile or run Unreal projects.
It does not replace Epic Games documentation or project-specific engine source review.
It cannot verify runtime behavior without project files, build logs, or reproduction steps.

use_cases.title: Review Gameplay Classes
use_cases.description: Check actor and component designs for lifecycle, Tick, and garbage collection issues before review.

use_cases.title: Set Team Coding Standards
use_cases.description: Create consistent Unreal C++ guidance for naming, reflection exposure, and Blueprint access rules.

use_cases.title: Debug UE5 C++ Patterns
use_cases.description: Investigate memory, reference, and loading problems using Unreal-specific implementation advice.

prompt_templates.title: Check a New Actor
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small Unreal C++ class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Unreal Engine 5 actor for UObject safety, Tick usage, naming, and Blueprint exposure. Explain each issue in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Component Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate refactor of actor and component initialization.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this actor and component setup. Recommend changes for constructor setup, PostInitializeComponents, BeginPlay, cached references, and delegate cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Runtime Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Unreal C++ gameplay system for hot-loop casting, Tick work, synchronous loading, hard references, and avoidable Blueprint writes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a UE5 C++ System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an Unreal Engine 5 C++ feature architecture for this gameplay requirement. Cover UObject ownership, reflection boundaries, asset references, delegates, and logging.

output_examples.input: Review an actor that enables Tick, stores UObject pointers, and exposes state to Blueprint.
output: Flags Tick as a performance cost and suggests event-driven logic or timers.
Identifies UObject members that need garbage collection tracking.
Recommends BlueprintReadOnly for state that should stay controlled by C++.

output_examples.input: Ask how to reduce load chains from actor class references.
output: Explains why hard class references can force asset loading.
Suggests soft class or object references for deferred loading.
Notes that asynchronous loading is preferred when blocking load time matters.

output_examples.input: Prepare a pull request checklist for a UE5 gameplay class.
output: Checks that UObject references are tracked correctly.
Checks that delegates and handles are cleaned up during shutdown.

best_practices: Ask for guidance with relevant headers, source files, and the Unreal Engine version.
Request reviews for lifecycle, ownership, reflection, performance, and Blueprint boundaries together.
Use the final advice as a review checklist before compiling and testing in Unreal Editor.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for non-Unreal engines or Blueprint-only work.
Do not ask it to guess project behavior without code, logs, or reproduction steps.
Do not treat guidance as a substitute for compiling, profiling, and testing in the target project.

faq.question: Does this skill support Unreal Engine 4?
faq.answer: It is written for Unreal Engine 5.x. Some guidance may apply to UE4, but compatibility is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Can it write complete Unreal C++ classes?
faq.answer: It can guide class structure and review generated code, but project-specific compilation still requires your Unreal setup.

faq.question: Does it handle Blueprint-only projects?
faq.answer: No. The skill is intended for projects that use Unreal Engine C++.

faq.question: Can it find garbage collection issues?
faq.answer: It can identify common UObject ownership risks when you provide relevant headers and source files.

faq.question: Will it optimize performance automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Unreal-specific performance patterns, but profiling and testing remain required.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during code review?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Unreal-specific review criteria for C++ gameplay code.
